items.title: Isaiah Morgan Interview, 1958-12-01
items.q: slow drag, Pauvajon the bass player

ctx.x: Or what kind of pieces did you play? We played everything. We played waltzes. We had some places we played, we had to play shorters. And Frenchman downtown you had to play a shorters like at E climbing hall you had to play a shorters. Once in about 11 o'clock or 12 o'clock. I don't know if you ever seen one of them dance.
No, I think maybe I saw slow drag demonstrated once, you know, slow drag, Pauvajon the bass player. But I don't know anything about it.

Well, they had, they used to dance them for prizes. Now these little youngsters, they have to sit on. They had to sit on. The guys used to sit on a glass of water right up on their head and they danced. And don't waste a drap. They just turned around and all the way around, right and left. Then we played waltzes, like two waltzes. We played two blues. We played mostly jazz numbers. Well, we played the blues around about 12 o'clock. Well, we looked for a fight then, you understand. Why do the blues do that?
